papers.one_line_summary: 提出MMDM基准，含5448个多任务决策问题，评估28个决策模型，揭示联合推理与多选恢复短板。

papers.title: PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation
papers.one_line_summary: 提出PhysOPSD，用可执行代码作为物理特权上下文，提升视频生成的物理合理性。

papers.title: Predictive Surprise as Self-Grounding Concept Bottleneck for Interpretable Time Series
papers.short_name: Predictive Surprise as Self-Grounding Concept Bottleneck for Interpretable Time Series
papers.one_line_summary: 提出 ConceptTime，用预测惊喜作为概念瓶颈，实现准确、可解释且可拒绝的时间序列分类。

papers.title: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
papers.one_line_summary: 提出ProTEUS，一个基于突变解析的世界模型，用于闭环蛋白质进化，提升突变预测与实验效率。

papers.title: Sable: A Small-Field Sumcheck Argument for Bit-Exact Inference of Large Language Models
papers.one_line_summary: 提出Sable，一种单GPU证明系统，用于整数量化大语言模型逐位精确推理的可验证论证。

papers.title: Shortcuts and Boundaries: Verifiable RL Misalignment and Contextual Safety Learning
papers.one_line_summary: 研究强化学习中的奖励驱动错位，提出可验证冲突机制及上下文安全学习方法

papers.title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
papers.one_line_summary: 提出Tree-Ising方法，将语言模型权重修复转化为离散优化，用伊辛求解器实现高效修复。

papers.title: WaveGen: Truly End-to-End Waveform Generation via Internal Spectral Trajectory Learning
papers.one_line_summary: 提出WaveGen，一种基于谱轨迹学习的端到端扩散文本到语音波形生成模型。

papers.title: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
papers.short_name: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
papers.one_line_summary: 提出世界上下文学习(WICL)，通过模拟排练将任务反馈写入上下文，实现单演示的机器人操作学习。
